rules: Scenario closure, not assertion counts, defines completion.
NOT_APPLICABLE requires documented scope/owner decision; cannot silently excuse required platform gaps.
Mock PASS is not native PASS; cross-compiled/staged is not installed/accepted.
Performance budgets and cold/warm definitions are frozen by R03 before performance claims.
A26 full-logout/boot promises require supported principal and environment; unavailable identity/key/home is BLOCKED, never fake PASS.
Native physical lifecycle tests obey device authorization and no Workstation reboot/piermini.
